purpose: Teach: こむ/採っ/ひざ/向く/在る/挙句/物語っ/できあがっ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが急いで駆けこむお姿が頼もしかったわ
lines.en: Sho, the way your father rushed in was really dependable.
lines.style: Warm, slightly nostalgic tone. Soft opening. Pace is measured and reflective. Genuine affection in the voice without making it about herself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと花を採ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I picked flowers together!
lines.style: Bright, excited burst. Eager energy right from the start. Quick pace, almost tumbling over the words. Genuine childlike enthusiasm without artificial cuteness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがひざに乗せて下さって嬉しかったね
lines.en: Sho, I was so happy that your dad let you sit on his lap.
lines.style: Tender, present tone. Slow, deliberate pace. Focuses gently on the moment itself—not performing emotion but genuinely reflecting on something precious. Quiet landing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの方を向くと笑顔になるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, when I look at Dad's face, I can't help but smile.
lines.style: Simple, honest delivery. Small genuine warmth in the voice. Natural pause before 'smile' — like he's discovering it as he says it. No performance, just truth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがいつもそばに在るから安心ね
lines.en: Sho, because Mei-sis is always right here, I feel safe.
lines.style: Soft, intimate tone. Slow opening. Each phrase lands with quiet certainty. The reassurance of presence, not words. Slight warmth at the end—she means it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが議論の挙句に「行こう」と仰ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad talked about it for a while, then said 'let's go.'
lines.style: Bright, matter-of-fact narration. Quick tempo, conversational. Small lift on 'let's go' — like he's proud of how Dad decided. No dramatization, just reportage.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがご家族の歴史を物語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father shared your family's stories with us.
lines.style: Reflective, reverent note. Slower pace. Slight emphasis on 'shared'—recognizing the gift of it. Warm underneath. Ends with quiet respect for the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと工作ができあがって嬉しい
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I finished the craft project together, and it made me so happy.
lines.style: Warm closure. Bright but grounded energy. Slight crescendo on 'happy' but not overwrought. A small child's genuine satisfaction—uncomplicated and whole.
